llm_response.reason: The website displays multiple scam signals: (1) missing privacy policy/contact info, (2) recent SSL certificate creation date indicative of a new, potentially disposable domain, (3) ambiguous claim to 'safe shopping' and pushing urgency sales tactics without legitimate business disclosures, (4) SSL certificate issues upon access, and (5) lack of proper company details. These combine to fit the scam characteristics of fake online shopping sites.
